description: Machine-readable index of workflows in this registry. Each entry points at a self-contained directory under workflows/ with its own README.md (full instructions), AGENTS.md (short pointer for auto-loading agent tools), scripts/, and references/.

workflows.name: Narrated Demo Video
workflows.summary: Adds a single continuous, precisely-synced AI voiceover to a silent screen-recording demo video by rebuilding the video's timing to match the narration (trim/freeze-extend per scene) instead of forcing narration into fixed video cues.
workflows.verification: Built and validated end-to-end on a real 3.5-minute product demo video; automated verify_video.js confirmed 0.015s video/audio duration delta and a 1.03s max silence gap (well under the 2s threshold).

workflows.name: Git Timesheet
workflows.summary: Reconstructs a day-by-day timesheet from git commit history across one or more local repos for a given date range, intelligently filling the gap days between sparse commits and writing plain, humanized, non-AI-sounding descriptions grounded in the actual diffs.
workflows.verification: Ran end-to-end against 4 real local repos (up to 44 commits each). Caught and fixed a real bug where git log --since/--until filters on committer date, not author date -- 34 of 43 commits in one repo had a rewritten committer date and were silently misplaced/dropped before the fix. Confirmed gap-day neighbor detection, multi-alias author filtering (3 identities for one person in one repo), binary-file numstat parsing (26 binary entries across repos), and character/AI-phrasing sanitization all work against real data.

workflows.name: Daily Standup
workflows.summary: Reconstructs an accurate, concise 3-part daily standup (Yesterday, Today, Blockers) from local git activity across one or more repos, grounding today's work in working tree diffs and stashes while enforcing brevity and stripping AI corporate puffery.
workflows.verification: Validated end-to-end against local git repos and multi-repo test scenarios. Verified automatic Monday 3-day lookback logic, working tree diffstat parsing, stash discovery, cross-platform UTF-8 console output, and deterministic linter rejection of verbose bullets and banned AI clichés.
